name: Averru
description: The last numen, who is the city itself; son of Zagorka.

description_citations.text: "Scourge (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of the Primevals, Averru traps the red Primeval Rhammidarigaaz beneath a caldera in Shiv and gains the dragon's powers.
timeline.quote: Averru trapped the red Primeval Rhammidarigaaz beneath a caldera in Shiv

citation.text: "Averru", section "Ancient Dominion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Averru takes part in killing the white and green Numena, leaving only himself, Lowallyn and Kuberr.
timeline.quote: Averru participated in killing the white and the green Numena

citation.text: "Averru", section "Ancient Dominion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the birth of Karona ends the Numena's rule, Averru creates a spell to resurrect himself as a giant city.
timeline.quote: Averru created a spell to resurrect himself as a giant city

citation.text: "Averru", section "Ancient Dominion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's arrival during the battle between Akroma and Phage disrupts Averru's plans by triggering the rebirth of Karona.
timeline.quote: disrupted Averru's plans by triggering the Rebirth of Karona

citation.text: "Averru", section "Reawakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona blasts Averru with pure magic, destroying him and the city; the last numen dies.
timeline.quote: The city was destroyed, and the god with it.

citation.text: "Averru", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Above Averru, Karona is drawn by Arien and trapped by the three Numena; Kamahl stops their assault and has her banished.
timeline.quote: Kamahl chose to see her banished from their world instead

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three numena set a trap with Kamahl to seal Karona, but he stops it, allowing her to escape the plane.
timeline.quote: He stops the plan at the last moment, allowing Karona, with Sash and Waistcoat in tow, to escape the plane.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona returns with an army and overcomes the defenders at Averru, killing the numena and taking the Mirari sword.
timeline.quote: The numena are killed, and only Kamahl stands with the Mirari sword.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sash and Waistcoat recover the blade and drive it through Karona on Lord Macht's instruction.
timeline.quote: Sash, and Waistcoat recover the blade and drive it through her

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Zagorka, having reawakened the soul of Averru by reviving the city of Sanctum, was this numen's spiritual and titular Mother.
